text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). Given the MRI findings of non-enhancing, multifocal demyelinating lesions in the context of your ataxia, this is highly suggestive of JC virus reactivation. To determine the underlying cause of your immunosuppression, I need to know: Do you have a known history of HIV/AIDS, are you currently on chemotherapy or immunosuppressive therapy, or have you received a stem cell transplant?
